name: 19973 · Seaford, DE
findings: ZIP 19973 (Seaford) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19973 (Seaford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19973 (Seaford) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
